title: Red/Green Luffy
summary: A green/red deck with a defensive Leader. When you're attacked, the Leader can rest your spare DON!! to give +2000 power each, so you lose Life slowly while your big Characters take over.
gamePlan: Give your Leader 1 DON!! on your turn. It stays given during your opponent's turn, which switches on the Leader's [DON!! x1] defense.
When your opponent attacks and you have 5 or fewer active DON!!, rest any number of them: +2000 power per DON!! to your Leader or a Straw Hat Crew Character for that battle.
Nami (OP14-031) is key: a [Blocker] that rests 2 opponent Characters and stands up to 5 of your DON!! at the end of your turn, ready for the Leader's defense.
Mid to late game: Jewelry Bonney draws 2 and plays 2 small Characters, Oden and Kawamatsu add 6000-power bodies, and Shanks finishes.

keyCards.why: Leader. Turns unused DON!! into +2000 power each on defense.
Blocker that rests 2 enemy Characters and readies 5 DON!! for your defense.
7000 power, draws 2 and plays 2 cheap Characters for free.
Draws and keeps an opponent's Character from attacking.
10-cost finisher with [Rush] that rests your opponent's board.

howItWins: Survive, then overwhelm. Your Leader soaks attacks using spare DON!!, Bonney and Nami build a bigger board than your opponent's, and Shanks closes the game.
weakTo: [Banish] and [Double Attack] attackers that get damage through faster than you can defend.
Opponents who make you spend DON!! on your turn, leaving none for the Leader's defense.
mulliganTips: Keep cheap searchers plus a 4 or 5 cost play. Nami (OP14-031) in your opening hand is great.
